location: Hybrid (2 days per week from HPE office)
description: The Infrastructure team under Apstra owns and evolves the backend infrastructure for Apstra. Join a team where systems and data engineering converge. You'll work at the core of a high-performance, custom-built infrastructure platform—while also helping shape the data pipelines that power our next-gen cloud analytics stack. This role offers rare dual exposure: from low-level optimization in performance-critical systems, to hands-on feature development in in-house time-series and graph databases. You’ll contribute to building and refining connectivity for these databases to the cloud, driving real-world data flows across hybrid environments.
responsibilities: Maintains and enhances the backend platform that powers Apstra’s configuration, telemetry, and analytics pipeline.
Owns: Product packaging, upgrades, and deployment orchestration
Homegrown file-based telemetry database (custom-built, optimized for performance)
Distributed querying, data merging, system calls, IPC
Python + C++ hybrid execution, including C-extensions for performance
Enables data synchronization from on-prem Apstra to on JCloud.
Constructs data pipelines and ETL flows to prepare, transform, and deliver telemetry for downstream cloud analytics consumers.
Owns cloud enablement and sync logic (e.g. examples datasets, format normalization, usage signals).
educationRequirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
